thread:
sasha: Heads up — prepping a new org for the Kestrel pilot (multi-cloud). Need a quick preflight: GPU quota requests across AWS/GCP/Azure, networking limits (EIPs, ENIs, subnet IPs), billing linkage, and IAM/service account setup. ETA: next Wed. Anyone available to sanity-check ask list?
phillip: I can take this. Quick checklist first: 1) desired region(s) + instance types 2) concurrency (max GPUs simultaneously) 3) burst vs reserved capacity 4) tags/cost-center info 5) required VPC peering / PrivateLink 6) support level for SLA.
phillip: For AWS we usually request EC2 quota increases for specific AZs: "Running On-Demand Standard (A, C, D, H, I, M, R, T, Z) instances" and specify instance families (p3, p4d, g5). Also raise ENI and IPv4 address quotas if we attach many nodes.
sasha: Regions: us-west-2 primary, us-east-1 fallback, eu-west-1 for EU pilot. Instance families: g5/ p4d where available. Concurrency: up to 40 GPUs peak, typical steady 12. Tags: team=ml, project=kestrel, cost_center=pilot-ops. Billing: link to infra-billing account 0xCAFEBABE.
tori: For GCP: request quota for GPUs per region (e.g., A100, V100). Use the GCP quota request form with these fields: project, region, metric (GPUs (all regions) -> specific GPU type), requested delta. Also request increased VPC reserved IPs if we're using cluster-autoscaler and many nodes.
tori: Note: GCP has per-project quota AND per-region quota for GPUs — include both. Also ask for "Compute Engine API" enabled and quota for VPN tunnels if we plan cross-project networking.
samir: Sample AWS support text I use: "Account: <account-id>. Region: us-west-2. We request quota increase for On-Demand p4d.24xlarge instances from X -> Y to support a new inference fleet for project Kestrel. Peak concurrent GPUs: 40 across AZs. Expected steady-state: 12. Purpose: production inference. Requested by <name>, contact <email/phone>." 
samir: For ENI/EIP ask: "We expect up to N worker nodes with 1 public ENI each; please increase Elastic IP limit from 5 -> 50 and ENIs per region from 350 -> 1000."
phillip: Azure: request GPU quota in target region (NCas_T4_v3, ND...), and check cores/quota in quotas blade. Also file a support ticket for capacity reservation if pilot needs guaranteed placement.
phillip: Networking: ask cloud teams for /24 subnets per AZ if we anticipate many pods with host-network or many node groups. Also request increase for NAT gateway bandwidth or add extra egress NATs if cost/throughput matters.
sasha: Can we get a concrete list of numbers to send? I want to open all three provider tickets today.
tori: Draft numbers based on Sasha's input: AWS p4d: 4 -> 10 instances (4 p4d = 64 GPUs -> wait that seems too big) — better: request GPUs, not instances. So: AWS GPUs: increase p4d GPU count in us-west-2 to 48, and in us-east-1 to 24. ENIs -> 1000, Elastic IPs -> 50. GCP A100 GPUs in us-west1 -> 32, eu-west1 -> 16. Azure ND GPUs -> 24.
samir: Also include expected baseline monthly hours (for support): ~10k GPU-hours/month expected during pilot. That helps justify quota bump.
phillip: IAM/billing notes: create a service account 'kestrel-inferer' with least privilege IAM role: compute.viewer, storage.objectViewer, kms.decrypt for model keys. Create tag policy enforcement: all infra resources must include 'team' and 'cost_center'. Link project to infra-billing account 0xCAFEBABE and enable billing export to BigQuery/S3 for cost reports.
sasha: Perfect. Can you paste the actual ticket bodies? I'll copy/paste to each provider portal.
phillip: AWS case body (copy/paste):
```
Account: 123456789012
Region: us-west-2 (primary), us-east-1 (fallback)
Resource: GPU quota (p4d / g5 families) — request increase
Current limit: [please confirm]
Requested new GPU quota: us-west-2: 48 GPUs; us-east-1: 24 GPUs
ENI quota increase: from default -> 1000
Elastic IPs: 50
Reason: Supporting Kestrel pilot (inference fleet). Peak concurrent GPUs: 40. Expected monthly GPU-hours: ~10000. Contact: sasha@redwood.ai
```
phillip: GCP request (short form):
```
Project: projects/kestrel-pilot
Region: us-west1, europe-west1
Quota: A100 GPUs (all regions) -> request: us-west1: 32, europe-west1: 16
Additional: Increase static external IP quota from 8 -> 50
Reason: inference fleet for Kestrel pilot. Peak concurrent GPUs: 40. Contact: sasha@redwood.ai
```
phillip: Azure ticket snippet: "Subscription: <sub-id>. Region: westus2. Quota: ND series GPU cores -> request 24. Increase Public IPs from 5 -> 50. Reason: production inference pilot for Kestrel."
phillip: Also attach expected deployment plan (node sizes, autoscaler limits), and ask for any soft limits that can be lifted faster via chat w/ capacity team.
nori (typo, but someone reacts): :thumbsup:
samir: small ops note: when filling AWS console form, choose "Service limit increase" -> EC2 -> "Running On-Demand G instances" and pick the metric that maps to the instance family. Link to internal playbook: https://internal.redwood/infra/quota-requests (replace w/ proper link).
tori: tagging reminder: add labels: team=kestrel, env=pilot, owner=sasha. Also enable stackdriver/monitoring export so SRE can watch GPU utilization.
sasha: thanks all — I'm going to open tickets now. I'll paste case numbers here as I get them. If any cloud capacity team reaches back asking for more detail, I'll @ the owners.
devops-bot: Ticket created: AWS Case #1234567 for p4d quota increase. Assigned: phillip.
sasha: saw it, thanks. I'll update thread with GCP/Azure IDs once created.
phillip: If AWS asks for justification, say: workload is latency-sensitive inference with SLOs; fallback to smaller GPU types acceptable but prefer p4d for throughput.
tori: reminder: schedule a follow-up sync Thu to verify quotas are approved and update deployment runbook.
samir: I'll draft terraform snippets to create service account and tagging policy after quotas land.
sasha: great — closing loop later. :rocket:
